title: Cosmética / profesional
desc: Un texto sobre la industria cosmética, formulación, regulación o innovación en el sector.
prompt: about the cosmetics industry — for example product development, ingredients, regulation, sustainability, or innovation in cosmetics manufacturing

title: Actualidad
desc: Un texto de interés general: tecnología, ciencia, negocios o cultura.
prompt: about a current general-interest topic such as technology, science, business, or culture — nothing overly technical, suitable for a general adult reader

title: Sorpréndeme
desc: Un tema variado y aleatorio, para salir de lo habitual.
prompt: about any topic you find genuinely interesting — surprise the learner with variety, avoid repeating common topics
